write_up: This is a strong construction project manager resume! At Capitol Builders, you show the value and number of projects you run alongside a grocery build delivered ahead of schedule. A recruiter can see the work and has reason to move it forward.

The grocery store line is the model: it names the build, its value, and the schedule result. Your current role leads, and Experience sits above Education, so the progression from Assistant Project Manager is easy to follow.

Start by adding how you kept change orders under 3% if you can describe your part. Your resume isn't likely to be what holds you back; competition for a particular role and referrals can still matter.
